iteration_0.issue: Forecast initialization uses day 0 instead of the last observed training day
iteration_0.impact: Forecasts for days 30–39 do not condition on the actual agent-level state at the end of training, leading to biased and potentially large RMSE against observed data.
iteration_0.solution: Initialize mask/info states from the last available training day (e.g., day 29), and compute time_since_first_info from training history. Start the forward simulation from day 30. Alternatively, replay days 0–29 with observed states to align latent counters and then forecast.

iteration_0.issue: No calibration despite specification of calibration_method=CMA-ES
iteration_0.impact: Default parameters are not tuned to data, causing suboptimal fit (high RMSE) and undermining the predictive validity of the model.
iteration_0.solution: Add a calibration loop minimizing RMSE against the training series by tuning a subset of parameters (e.g., base_adoption_rate, beta_* weights, messaging_effect_size). Implement a lightweight random/Nelder-Mead optimizer with an optional PyCMA (CMA-ES) fallback.

iteration_0.impact: The task asks to predict agents’ mask-wearing behavior for days 30–39. Aggregate-only outputs miss this requirement and limit downstream analyses.
iteration_0.solution: Record agent-level mask states for each forecast day and output a per-agent prediction file (day, agent_id, predicted_wearing_mask).

iteration_0.issue: time_to_threshold returns indices, not actual simulation days
iteration_0.impact: Reported threshold times are misleading, particularly if simulation days are not zero-based or if the forecast starts after the training period.
iteration_0.solution: Modify time_to_thresholds to accept the days array and return actual day values.
